title: Chapter 1410 - 19: Three Methods (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1410 - 19: Three Methods (Part 2)

Chapter 1410: Chapter 19: Three Methods (Part 2)

"There is no need for such formalities between us."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor standing in the middle smiled and said, "My name is ’Three-Life’, from now on you can just call me Three-Life."

"My name is ’Wu Yu’. "

"My name is ’Dao You’. "

The Immortal Emperors standing on the left and right spoke in succession, their tone kind.

"I am called Tianyuan."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The three Immortal Emperors of the Great Wilderness Origin World are Three-Life, Wu Yu, and Dao You.

Among them, the Three-Life Immortal Emperor is also the first Immortal Emperor, the discoverer of the illusory world.

Wu Yu Immortal Emperor and Dao You Immortal Emperor were born after the major Immortal path was opened.

...

The manifestations of will of the three Immortal Emperors descended to meet Lin Yuan, the invisible aura they emitted caused the surrounding space-time to become chaotic, and the pupils of the Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings who were originally observing shrunk instantly.

"Immortal Emperor, the three Immortal Emperors have come to see Tianyuan."

Many Red Dust Immortals understood in their hearts and quickly began to discuss.

The majority of the three Immortal Emperors’ attention was focused on locking onto the illusory world, even if something major happened, they would only directly contact those few pinnacle Immortal Kings.

As for personally descending as manifestations of consciousness, it was unknown how long it had been since that happened.

"Tianyuan..."

The Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King exchanged glances.

The personal presence of the three Immortal Emperors and the release of a signal meant that Lin Yuan was already capable of comparing with the Immortal Emperors.

If this weren’t the case, it wouldn’t be possible for the three Immortal Emperors to arrive together; even if there were a significant event, at most one Immortal Emperor’s consciousness manifestation would suffice.

Why should all three come?

The main reason for the three Immortal Emperors coming together was to show their regard for Lin Yuan.

Realizing this, the Reincarnation Immortal King and other Immortal Kings felt emotional, remembering when Lin Yuan first arrived on the Immortal path, and how soon after he was equated with the Immortal Emperors.

...

"Tianyuan, which type of Chaotic Origin Dao have you realized?"

Dao You Immortal Emperor was quite curious.

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor and Wu Yu Immortal Emperor also looked at Lin Yuan.

"I call it the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao." Lin Yuan did not hide it, raising his right hand, where black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power wove and clashed.

The Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao was comprehended by him, and other beings of time could not seize it.

Moreover, as the pioneer of this Origin Dao, even if beings in the future walk this path, they would be under his jurisdiction.

"Remarkable."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor observed the operation of the black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Power closely, nodding slightly.

The higher the realm, the more revered such an Origin Dao becomes, and at least the Three-Life Immortal Emperor himself could absolutely not comprehend a Dao of such a level.

"I wouldn’t have comprehended it without the guidance of this illusory world," Lin Yuan said.

"So many Red Dust Immortals were guided for long ages but never comprehended such an Origin Dao," Wu Yu Immortal Emperor chuckled; guidance, after all, depends on the person.

The Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao isn’t something that mere guidance can reveal.

"Tianyuan, how have you concealed your own timeline? What means did you use?" Wu Yu Immortal Emperor smiled.

"I once had the opportunity to obtain the status of a Lord," Lin Yuan said.

The status of a Lord is incredibly precious for beings of the First Realm and Second Realm, but for Immortal Emperors of the same level, it isn’t much.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he’s perfectly capable of maintaining the status of a Lord without concern.

"I see."

Wu Yu Immortal Emperor nodded.

He was still curious what means Lin Yuan had used to achieve such a degree of blocking his own timeline.

It’s important to know that before, Lin Yuan was not an Immortal Emperor, not even an Immortal King, and none of the three Immortal Emperors noticed anything amiss.

"I see you’ve already condensed your past self, how does it feel?" The Three-Life Immortal Emperor looked at Lin Yuan and asked.

"Incredibly profound," Lin Yuan said solemnly, knowing that in front of him was the source of the ninth type of Physical Body Divine Ability.

Even the "past self" was merely a part of the Three-Life Immortal Emperor’s methods, with even more obscure "future self" to come.

"This ’Past Self’, with the present self as a foundational anchor point, is condensed along the past timeline. Once successfully condensed, mastery over one’s own timeline becomes easier, extending from the past and present to the future."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor looked at Lin Yuan, "However, to condense the ’Past Self’, the threshold is extremely high, heavily reliant on talent. I have passed down related legacies before, but not a single being has mastered it."

Lin Yuan listened obediently.

Condensing the ’Past Self’ mainly relies on the fundamental power deep within one’s bloodline, which is referred to as ’talent’ by the Three-Life Immortal Emperor.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding also plays a significant role, for without it, even if the related divine skills are awakened, it would take ages to completely condense it.

"For beings like us," the ’Past Self’ also has an even more important function, involving the path to transcendence, and you will realize this in time."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor spoke with profound meaning.

"Path to transcendence?"

Lin Yuan was quite curious.

He knew the ultimate pursuit of the Time Lords is transcendence.

Transcend fate.

Transcend constraints.

However, currently, Lin Yuan only knows that for the Time Lords to transcend, they must step into the Fourteenth Rank and become a Perfect Time Being.

A Perfect Time Being dictates the past, present, and future, which is the true form of great transcendence and great freedom.

And from what the Three-Life Immortal Emperor implied, aside from becoming a Perfect Time Being, there are other methods of transcendence.

Or perhaps, the ’Past Self’ may also aid in becoming a Perfect Time Being?

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged. Involving the path to transcendence, even at the lord level, it is considered a secret, which Lin Yuan hasn’t yet delved into.

The only Time Lord he currently interacts with is the Lord of Heaven Light, but the Lord of Heaven Light hasn’t left much related information.

"Since you’ve condensed the ’Past Self’, how is your insight into the ’Future Self’ coming along?" the Three-Life Immortal Emperor asked with interest.

His Three Lives Method involves the Past Self, Present Self, and Future Self, yet there has been no heir to it so far.

"No real leads yet," Lin Yuan replied.

Compared to condensing the Past Self, the Future Self is exceedingly obscure and difficult. However, after comprehending the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, Lin Yuan vaguely feels that his grasp of the future has improved by a significant margin.

If he continues to condense the Future Self, it should be much simpler.

"These are some of my insights into the ’Future Self’." The Three-Life Immortal Emperor flipped his right hand, and a crystal floated, hovering before Lin Yuan.

"Thank you." Lin Yuan’s heart stirred, and his mind delved into the crystal, immediately flooding his mind with vast information about the ’Future Self’, as well as the Past Self and Present Self.

Along with a complete set of the ’Three Lives Method’.

"These insights are extremely helpful to me," Lin Yuan said earnestly.

At this moment, he felt as though he could attempt to condense the Future Self right away.

"It helped a lot just by viewing it once?" The Three-Life Immortal Emperor was slightly puzzled, but he didn’t think much of it, assuming Lin Yuan was simply inspired.

In actuality, even if the ’Three Lives Method’ he created were made public, it would hold little meaning for those Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings, as no one can master it.

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor himself only conceived the ’Three Lives Method’ after stepping into the Immortal Emperor realm and realizing the past and future.

"If one can successfully condense the Future Self, Past Self, Present Self, and Future Self, overseeing the past, present, and future, one can then explore the infinite origin time nodes of the past."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor said.

"Explore the infinite origin time nodes of the past?"

Lin Yuan was slightly confused.

"Yes."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor nodded, seeming to understand Lin Yuan’s confusion, and explained: "This is also a path to transcendence, called ’Infinite Origin’."

"It is said that at the source of time, the origin point of everything, lies the ultimate secret of endless dimensions and realms being born and evolving. Reaching there also enables transcendence."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor looked at Lin Yuan and said.

Time Lords can travel back along the timeline to the past, and theoretically, they can reach the source of the timeline, which is the origin node of endless dimensions and realms.

"Transcendence?"

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn.

The transcendence method he knows of now is to become a Perfect Time Being.

This is also the path of transcendence chosen by the Lord of Heaven Light.

Yet the Three-Life Immortal Emperor mentioned another path to transcendence.

Infinite Origin!

"There are three methods, or rather three paths, we can choose for transcendence,"

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor said, "Infinite Origin is one, Perfect Life is another, and the third is ’Endless Tribulation’."
